words.english_meaning: A large self-service store selling food, household goods, and other items.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક મોટી સ્વ-સેવા દુકાન જ્યાં ખોરાક, ઘરવખરી અને અન્ય ચીજો વેચાય છે.
words.usage_note: Used for large stores with many departments under one roof.
words.memory_tip: 'Super' = મોટું + 'market' = બજાર → supermarket = મોટું બજાર.
examples: I buy vegetables from the supermarket every week.
The supermarket is open until midnight.
She found a great deal at the supermarket.
The supermarket has a bakery section.

words.english_meaning: A small shop selling fashionable clothes or accessories.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક નાની દુકાન જ્યાં ફેશનેબલ કપડાં અથવા ઍક્સેસરીઝ વેચાય છે.
words.usage_note: Usually implies a small, stylish, and often expensive shop.
words.memory_tip: 'Boutique' = ફ્રેન્ચ શબ્દ, નાની ફેન્સી દુકાન — like a VIP shop!
examples: She bought her wedding dress from a boutique.
The boutique on Main Street sells imported clothes.
They opened a boutique specializing in handmade jewelry.
The boutique was beautifully decorated.

words.english_meaning: A shop where medicines and healthcare products are sold.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં દવાઓ અને આરોગ્ય સંબંધી ઉત્પાદનો વેચાય છે.
words.usage_note: In British English 'chemist' is used; in American English 'drugstore' or 'pharmacy'.
words.memory_tip: 'Pharma' = દવા → pharmacy = દવાની દુકાન.
examples: Pick up my prescription from the pharmacy.
The pharmacy is next to the clinic.
She works as a pharmacist at the pharmacy.
The pharmacy stocks vitamins and supplements.

words.english_meaning: An outdoor market where people sell second-hand goods at low prices.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક ખુલ્લું બજાર જ્યાં લોકો સસ્તા ભાવે જૂની ચીજો વેચે છે.
words.usage_note: Often held on weekends; great for bargain hunting.
words.memory_tip: 'Flea' = ચાંચડ (નાનો) → નાની-નાની સસ્તી ચીજો મળે એ flea market.
examples: I found antique coins at the flea market.
The flea market opens every Sunday morning.
She loves browsing flea markets for vintage items.
They sold homemade crafts at the flea market.

words.english_meaning: A small shop open long hours selling everyday essential items.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક નાની દુકાન જે લાંબા સમય સુધી ખુલ્લી રહે અને રોજની જરૂરી ચીજો વેચે.
words.usage_note: Typically more expensive than supermarkets due to convenience.
words.memory_tip: 'Convenient' = સગવડભર્યું → convenience store = સગવડભરી દુકાน.
examples: I grabbed a snack from the convenience store.
The convenience store is open 24 hours.
She stopped at the convenience store for milk.
Convenience stores often sell lottery tickets.

words.english_meaning: A large retail store with separate sections for different types of goods.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક મોટી દુકાન જ્યાં જુદા-જુદા પ્રકારની ચીજો માટે અલગ-અલગ વિભાગ હોય.
words.usage_note: Examples: Walmart, Marks & Spencer, Shoppers Stop.
words.memory_tip: 'Department' = વિભાગ → department store = ઘણા વિભાગ વાળી દુકાન.
examples: We bought furniture from the department store.
The department store has a sale every Christmas.
She works in the cosmetics section of a department store.
The department store spans five floors.

words.english_meaning: A market where goods are sold in large quantities at lower prices, usually to retailers.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક બજાર જ્યાં ઘણો મોટો જથ્થો ઓછા ભાવે, ખાસ કરીને વેપારીઓને, વેચાય છે.
words.usage_note: Wholesale is cheaper per unit but requires buying in bulk.
words.memory_tip: 'Whole' = આખો/બધો → wholesale = બધો માલ એકસાથે ખરીદવો.
examples: Shopkeepers buy goods from the wholesale market.
The wholesale market opens early in the morning.
She visited the wholesale market to stock her store.
Prices at the wholesale market are much lower.

words.english_meaning: A shop where manufacturers sell products directly at discounted prices.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં ઉત્પાદક સીધા ઘટાડેલા ભાવે ઉત્પાદનો વેચે છે.
words.usage_note: Often located outside city centers; sells last season's stock or slight defects.
words.memory_tip: 'Outlet' = બહાર નીકળવાનો રસ્તો → manufacturer નો outlet = factory outlet store.
examples: I bought branded shoes from the outlet store.
The outlet store has up to 70% off.
She found designer handbags at the outlet.
Outlet stores are popular during holiday sales.

words.english_meaning: A shop where people can borrow money by leaving valuable items as security.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં ઘરેણા જેવી કીમતી વસ્તુ ગિરવી મૂકીને પૈસા ઉધાર મળે છે.
words.usage_note: If you repay the loan with interest, you get your item back.
words.memory_tip: 'Pawn' = ગિરવી → pawnshop = ગિરવી દુકાન (ઘરેણું ગિરવી, પૈસા મળે).
examples: He pawned his watch at the pawnshop.
The pawnshop gave her a loan against her gold ring.
She redeemed her jewelry from the pawnshop.
Pawnshops offer quick cash in emergencies.

words.english_meaning: A shop selling second-hand goods, often run by charities.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં ઉપયોગ થઈ ગયેલ ચીજો વેચાય છે, ઘણી વખત ધર્માદો સંસ્થા ચલાવે.
words.usage_note: Very popular in the US and UK; eco-friendly shopping option.
words.memory_tip: 'Thrift' = કરકસર → thrift store = કરકસર ભરી ખરીદી (સસ્તી, વાપરેલ ચીજો).
examples: She found a vintage jacket at the thrift store.
Thrift stores help reduce waste.
He donated old books to the thrift store.
Thrift shopping is trendy among young people.

words.english_meaning: A place where goods are sold to the highest bidder through a public sale.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક સ્થળ જ્યાં ચીજો જાહેર હરાજી દ્વારા સૌથી વધુ ભાવ આપનારને વેચાય.
words.usage_note: Famous auction houses include Sotheby's and Christie's.
words.memory_tip: 'Auction' = હરાજી → auction house = હરાજી ઘર.
examples: The painting sold for millions at the auction house.
She bid on antique furniture at the auction house.
Auction houses deal in art, jewelry, and collectibles.
He attended an auction house event last month.

words.english_meaning: A person or shop that sells flowers and floral arrangements.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક વ્યક્તિ અથવા દુકાન જ્યાં ફૂલ અને ફૂલ સજાવટ વેચાય છે.
words.usage_note: A florist can also arrange custom bouquets for events.
words.memory_tip: 'Flora' = ફૂલ-છોડ (Latin) → florist = ફૂલ વેચનાર.
examples: She ordered a bouquet from the florist.
The florist arranged flowers for the wedding.
The florist is open on Valentine's Day.
He works as a florist and loves his job.

words.english_meaning: A shop that sells writing materials, paper, pens, and office supplies.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં કાગળ, પેન, ઑફિસ સ્ટેશનરી અને લખવા-ભણવાની ચીજો મળે.
words.usage_note: Do not confuse 'stationery' (paper/pen) with 'stationary' (not moving).
words.memory_tip: 'Stationery' → 'e' for envelope → pen, paper, envelope — stationery shop!
examples: She bought notebooks from the stationery shop.
The stationery shop sells art supplies too.
Children visit the stationery shop before school.
The stationery shop is near the library.

words.english_meaning: A shop selling cooked meats, cheeses, and fine prepared foods.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં રાંધેલ માંસ, ચીઝ અને તૈયાર ખાસ ખોરાક મળે છે.
words.usage_note: Commonly shortened to 'deli'. Often sells sandwiches and imported foods.
words.memory_tip: 'Delicate' = નાજુક/ખાસ → delicatessen = ખાસ ખોરાકની દુકાન.
examples: He bought smoked salmon from the delicatessen.
The delicatessen makes excellent sandwiches.
She visited the deli for imported cheese.
The delicatessen is known for its gourmet products.

words.english_meaning: A shop selling tools, building materials, and home improvement products.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં સાધનો, બાંધકામ સામગ્રી અને ઘર સુધારણાની ચીજો મળે.
words.usage_note: In the UK, often called a 'DIY store' or 'ironmonger'.
words.memory_tip: 'Hard' + 'ware' = ઠોસ/કઠણ ચીજો → hardware store = ઓજારો ને સાધનોની દુકાન.
examples: Dad went to the hardware store to buy nails.
The hardware store sells paint and brushes.
She found a good drill at the hardware store.
The hardware store is helpful for home repairs.

words.english_meaning: A shop where books are sold.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાન જ્યાં પુસ્તકો વેચાય છે.
words.usage_note: 'Bookstore' is American English; 'bookshop' is British English.
words.memory_tip: 'Book' = પુસ્તક + 'store' = દુકાન → bookstore = પુસ્તકોની દુકાન.
examples: She spent hours browsing the bookstore.
The bookstore has a great children's section.
He bought a novel from the bookstore.
The bookstore hosts author signing events.

words.english_meaning: A shop that sells rings, necklaces, bracelets, and other ornaments.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક દુકાน જ્યાં વીંટી, હાર, બંગડી અને અન્ય ઘરેણા વેચાય છે.
words.usage_note: 'Jewellery' is British spelling; 'jewelry' is American spelling.
words.memory_tip: 'Jewel' = ઝવેર → jewellery shop = ઝવેરીની દુકાન.
examples: She bought gold earrings from the jewellery shop.
The jewellery shop has a wide collection.
He proposed with a ring from the local jewellery shop.
The jewellery shop offers free engraving.

words.english_meaning: Something bought for less than its usual price; also to negotiate a lower price.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઓછી કિંમતે ખરીદાયેલ ચીજ, અથવા ભાવ ઘટાડવા માટે વાટાઘાટ કરવી.
words.usage_note: As a verb: 'to bargain' = to negotiate price. As a noun: 'a bargain' = a great deal.
words.memory_tip: 'bar' = ઘટાડ + 'gain' = ફાયદો → bargain = સસ્તો ફાયદો.
examples: This jacket was a real bargain at half price.
She loves bargain hunting at flea markets.
They bargained for a lower price.
It's a bargain you can't refuse.

words.english_meaning: To buy something; or the act of buying something.
words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈ ખરીદવું; અથવા ખરીદીની ક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: 'Purchase' is more formal than 'buy'. Used in official receipts and documents.
words.memory_tip: 'pur' = સારી રીતે + 'chase' = પીછો → purchase = ચીજ પાછળ ધ્યાન આપી ખરીદવી.
examples: She made a purchase at the online store.
Please keep your purchase receipt.
The purchase was completed within minutes.
He purchased a new laptop yesterday.

words.english_meaning: A person or company that sells goods or services.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક વ્યક્તિ અથવા કંપની જે ચીજો અથવા સેવાઓ વેચે છે.
words.usage_note: Street vendors sell goods outdoors; online vendors sell through websites.
words.memory_tip: 'Vend' = વેચવું (Latin) → vendor = વેચનાર.
examples: The street vendor sells fresh fruit every morning.
We chose a reliable vendor for office supplies.
The food vendor set up a stall near the park.
Online vendors offer competitive prices.

words.english_meaning: A written or printed document confirming payment for goods or services.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખરીદી માટે ચૂકવણીની પુષ્ટિ આપતો લખિત અથવા છાપેલ કાગળ.
words.usage_note: Always keep your receipt in case you need to return or exchange an item.
words.memory_tip: 'Receive' = મળ્યું → receipt = મળ્યાની ચિઠ્ઠી.
examples: Can I have a receipt for this purchase?
Keep the receipt if you want to return it.
The receipt shows the date and price.
She lost her receipt and couldn't get a refund.

words.english_meaning: Money returned to a customer when they return a product or cancel a service.
words.gujarati_meaning: ગ્રાહક ચીજ પરત કરે અથવા સેવા રદ કરે ત્યારે પાછા અપાતા પૈસા.
words.usage_note: You may need the original receipt to claim a refund.
words.memory_tip: 'Re' = પાછું + 'fund' = પૈસા → refund = પૈસા પાછા.
examples: I asked for a refund because the item was defective.
The store gave me a full refund.
The refund was credited to my account.
Their refund policy allows 30 days.

words.english_meaning: To give one thing and receive another in return; to swap a product for a different one.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક ચીજ આપીને બીજી લેવી; ખરીદેલ ઉત્પાદ બદલાવવું.
words.usage_note: In shopping: exchange means replacing a product with a different size/colour.
words.memory_tip: 'Ex' = બહાર + 'change' = બદલ → exchange = બહાર-અંદર બદલવું.
examples: Can I exchange this shirt for a larger size?
The shop allows exchange within 7 days.
They exchanged gifts on Christmas.
The exchange rate affects international shopping.

words.english_meaning: The selling of goods in large quantities at lower prices, typically to retailers.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઓછા ભાવે મોટા જથ્થામાં ચીજો વેચવી, ખાસ કરીને દુકાનદારોને.
words.usage_note: Wholesale requires buying large quantities; not typically available to individual consumers.
words.memory_tip: 'Whole' = આખો → wholesale = આખો/ઘણો સામાન સસ્તામાં.
examples: She buys fabric wholesale for her boutique.
Wholesale prices are much lower than retail.
He is a wholesale dealer in electronics.
The wholesale market opens at 5 AM.

words.english_meaning: The sale of goods to individual consumers in small quantities.
words.gujarati_meaning: વ્યક્તિગત ગ્રાહકોને નાની માત્રામાં ચીજો વેચવી.
words.usage_note: Retail prices are higher than wholesale because of added costs.
words.memory_tip: 'Re' + 'tail' = ફરી + છેડો → retail = છેલ્લો ગ્રાહક સુધી વેચાણ.
examples: The retail price of this phone is ₹15,000.
She works in retail management.
The retail sector has grown this year.
Retail stores attract many shoppers on weekends.

words.english_meaning: To argue or negotiate over the price of something, especially in a market.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખાસ કરીને બજારમાં ભાવ ઘટાડવા માટે ઝઘડો/વાટાઘાટ કરવી.
words.usage_note: Haggling is common and expected in street markets and bazaars.
words.memory_tip: 'Haggle' = ઘા-ઘૂ → ઘા-ઘૂ કરી ભાવ ઘટાડવો — that's haggling!
examples: She haggled the price down by 30%.
Don't be afraid to haggle at the market.
He haggled with the vendor for 10 minutes.
Haggling is a skill that saves money.

words.english_meaning: An offer of a specific price for something at an auction or in a competition.
words.gujarati_meaning: હરાજી અથવા સ્પર્ધામાં ચોક્કસ ભાવ ઑફર કરવો.
words.usage_note: In online shopping (e.g., eBay), users bid to win items.
words.memory_tip: 'Bid' = બોલ → 'bid' = ભાવ બોલવો (in auction).
examples: She placed a bid of ₹5,000 on the antique vase.
The winning bid was much higher than expected.
He bid on several items at the auction.
Online bidding is common on platforms like eBay.

words.english_meaning: A document sent by a seller to a buyer, listing goods/services and the amount owed.
words.gujarati_meaning: વેચનાર દ્વારા ખરીદનારને મોકલવામાં આવેલ કાગળ, જેમાં ચીજો અને ચૂકવવાની રકમ હોય.
words.usage_note: Invoices are used in business transactions; receipts are given at retail stores.
words.memory_tip: 'In' + 'voice' = અંદર + અવાજ → invoice = ગ્રાહક સુધી પૈસા માટેનો 'અવાજ' (demand).
examples: Please send the invoice by email.
The invoice is due within 30 days.
She received an invoice for the repair service.
The invoice lists all items purchased.

words.english_meaning: Goods sent to a seller to sell on behalf of the owner, with payment after sale.
words.gujarati_meaning: માલ માલિક વતી વેચવા માટે વેચનારને મોકલવો, વેચ્યા પછી ચૂકવણી.
words.usage_note: In consignment selling, the seller only pays the supplier after goods are sold.
words.memory_tip: 'Con' + 'sign' = સાથે + સહી → consignment = સહી કરી માલ સોંપવો.
examples: She sells clothes on consignment at the boutique.
The consignment arrived yesterday.
He operates a consignment store for used goods.
Payment is made once the consignment is sold.

words.english_meaning: A reduction in the price of a product, often to clear stock.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઉત્પાદનની કિંમત ઘટાડવી, ઘણી વખત સ્ટૉક ખાલી કરવા.
words.usage_note: Opposite of markup; stores markdown prices during clearance sales.
words.memory_tip: 'Mark' = ભાવ + 'down' = નીચે → markdown = ભાવ નીચો.
examples: The store offered a 40% markdown on winter coats.
Items are marked down after the holiday season.
Look for markdowns to save money.
The markdown brought more customers in.

words.english_meaning: The amount added to the cost price of goods to cover expenses and profit.
words.gujarati_meaning: ચીજની કિંમત ઉપર ઉમેરાયેલ રકમ, ખર્ચ અને નફો આવરવા.
words.usage_note: A 50% markup means a product that costs ₹100 is sold for ₹150.
words.memory_tip: 'Mark' = ભાવ + 'up' = ઉપર → markup = ભાવ ઉપર.
examples: Luxury brands have a very high markup.
The markup on electronics is usually 20-30%.
She calculated the markup to determine the selling price.
High markups reduce customer loyalty.

words.english_meaning: An excess of production or stock beyond what is needed.
words.gujarati_meaning: જરૂર કરતા વધારે ઉત્પાદન અથવા સ્ટૉક.
words.usage_note: Surplus goods are often sold at reduced prices to clear inventory.
words.memory_tip: 'Sur' = ઉપર/વધારે (French/Latin) → surplus = વધારાનો.
examples: The store has a surplus of summer clothes.
Surplus food was donated to the charity.
A trade surplus means more exports than imports.
They sold surplus inventory at a discount.

words.english_meaning: A complete list of goods/products a business has in stock.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક વ્યવસાયમાં ઉપલબ્ધ ચીજોની સંપૂર્ણ યાદી.
words.usage_note: Regular inventory checks help businesses avoid stockouts or overstocking.
words.memory_tip: 'Invent' + 'ory' = ઊભું કરેલ + સ્થળ → inventory = ચીજો ઊભી કરેલ/રાખેલ જગ્યા.
examples: The manager did an inventory check this morning.
They use software for inventory management.
The inventory shows 50 units remaining.
Out-of-stock items need inventory restocking.

words.english_meaning: To send back a purchased item to the store, usually for a refund or exchange.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખરીદેલ ચીજ દુકાને પાછી આપવી, ઘણી વખત રિફંડ અથવા બદલી માટે.
words.usage_note: Most stores have a return window (e.g., 15 or 30 days) with receipt required.
words.memory_tip: 'Re' = પાછું + 'turn' = ફેરવ → return = ફરી પાછું ફેરવવું.
examples: I need to return these shoes; they don't fit.
The store has a 30-day return policy.
She returned the dress and got a full refund.
Returning items online is easy with prepaid labels.

words.english_meaning: A label attached to a product showing its price.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઉત્પાદ ઉપર લગાડેલ ટૅગ જે ભાવ દર્શાવે.
words.usage_note: Also used figuratively: 'the price tag of success' = the cost of achieving something.
words.memory_tip: 'Price' = ભાવ + 'tag' = ટૅગ/ચિઠ્ઠી → price tag = ભાવ ચિઠ્ઠી.
examples: Always check the price tag before buying.
She removed the price tag as a gift.
The price tag said ₹2,500.
Some luxury items don't display a price tag.

words.english_meaning: A reduction in the usual price of something.
words.gujarati_meaning: ચીજની સામાન્ย કિંમતમાં ઘટાડો.
words.usage_note: Discounts are given in percentage (10% off) or fixed amount (₹100 off).
words.memory_tip: 'Dis' = દૂર + 'count' = ગણ → discount = ભાવ ગણ દૂર (ઘટાડ).
examples: The shop offered a 20% discount on all items.
She got a student discount at the museum.
Are there any discounts for bulk buying?
The discount code saved me ₹500.

words.english_meaning: To discuss something to reach an agreement, especially about a price.
words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ વ્યાપારિક સોદો, ખાસ કરીને ભાવ અંગે, સંમતિ મળે ત્યાં સુધી ચર્ચા કરવી.
words.usage_note: Negotiation is a key business skill; also used in salary discussions.
words.memory_tip: 'Neg' + 'otiate' = ના + ઓ → negotiation = 'ના' ન પડે ત્યાં સુધી ચર્ચા.
examples: He negotiated the price down by ₹2,000.
She is good at negotiating deals.
They negotiated the terms of the contract.
Negotiate politely for best results.

words.english_meaning: A voucher that gives the holder a discount or special offer.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક વાઉચર જે ધારક ને ડિસ્કાઉન્ટ અથવા ખાસ ઑફર આપે.
words.usage_note: Coupons can be physical (cut from a newspaper) or digital (promo codes online).
words.memory_tip: 'Coupon' = ફ્રેન્ચ 'couper' (કાપવું) → coupon = ભાવ ઘટાડો ક્યારેક.
examples: Use this coupon to get 15% off.
She collected coupons from magazines.
Enter the coupon code at checkout.
The coupon expires at the end of the month.

words.english_meaning: A period when a shop sells goods at reduced prices.
words.gujarati_meaning: એવો સમય જ્યારે દુકાન ઘટાડેલ ભાวે ચીજો વેચે.
words.usage_note: 'On sale' means reduced price. 'For sale' means available to buy.
words.memory_tip: 'Sale' = વેચાણ → સસ્તામાં ઘણો 'sale' (વેચાણ) — great deals!
examples: The shop has a big sale every January.
These shoes are on sale for half price.
She waited for the sale to buy the coat.
Flash sales last only a few hours.

words.english_meaning: Priced too high; costing more than the item is worth.
words.gujarati_meaning: ભાવ ઘણો વધારે, ચીજ જેટલી કિંમત છે તેના કરતા ઘણી મોંઘી.
words.usage_note: Used when the buyer feels they are not getting value for money.
words.memory_tip: 'Over' = વધારે + 'priced' = ભાવ → overpriced = ભાવ ઘણો વધારે.
examples: This coffee is so overpriced for what you get.
Tourists often pay overpriced rates.
The hotel was luxurious but overpriced.
I refused to buy the overpriced souvenir.

words.english_meaning: Reasonably priced; not too expensive to buy.
words.gujarati_meaning: વ્યાજબી ભાવ; ખૂબ મોંઘી ન હોય.
words.usage_note: 'Afford' = to have enough money. 'Affordable' = priced within reach.
words.memory_tip: 'Afford' = ભોગવી શકવું → affordable = ભોગવી શકાય એ ભાવ.
examples: This restaurant offers affordable meals.
We found an affordable apartment near the city.
The brand is known for affordable fashion.
Are there any more affordable options?

words.english_meaning: A stated price for a product or service before purchase; to state such a price.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખરીદી પહેલા ઉત્પાદ/સેવા માટે જણાવેલ ભાવ; ભાว જણાવવો.
words.usage_note: 'Quote' and 'quotation' are interchangeable for prices.
words.memory_tip: 'Quote' = 'quotation' = ભાવ-ચિઠ્ઠી → quote = ભાવ જણાવ.
examples: Can you give me a quote for the renovation?
The plumber quoted ₹3,000 for the repair.
She got three quotes before choosing a supplier.
The quote was much higher than expected.

words.english_meaning: An approximate calculation of cost or value.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખર્ચ અથવા મૂલ્યની અંદાજિત ગણતરી.
words.usage_note: Estimates can be rough or detailed; they may change once work begins.
words.memory_tip: 'Estimate' = 'estimate' (અંગ્રેજી) = અંદાજ → estimate = અંદાજ.
examples: The contractor gave a rough estimate of ₹50,000.
We estimated the total cost at ₹1 lakh.
Please send a written estimate by Friday.
The actual cost was close to the estimate.

words.english_meaning: Getting good quality or quantity in exchange for the price paid.
words.gujarati_meaning: ચૂકવેલ ભાવ અનુસાર સારી ગુણવત્તા અથવા માત્રા મળવી.
words.usage_note: Often used in reviews: 'This product offers excellent value for money.'
words.memory_tip: 'Value' = મૂલ્ય + 'money' = પૈસા → value for money = પૈસા ઉઠ્ઠાં = worthwhile!
examples: This all-inclusive hotel is great value for money.
The course offered excellent value for money.
Cheap products aren't always value for money.
Consumers look for value for money when shopping.

words.english_meaning: A sale in which goods are sold cheaply to get rid of old stock.
words.gujarati_meaning: પૂરાણો સ્ટૉક ઓછા ભાવે ઉડાડી દેવા ગોઠવેલ વેચાણ.
words.usage_note: Clearance items often cannot be returned or exchanged.
words.memory_tip: 'Clear' = સાફ → clearance = સ્ટૉક સાફ (ઉડાડ) → clearance sale.
examples: I bought a coat in the clearance sale.
The clearance rack has 70% off items.
They held a clearance sale to make room for new stock.
Check clearance sections for the best deals.

words.english_meaning: The act of arguing or negotiating about the price of something.
words.gujarati_meaning: ભાવ ઘટાડવા માટે ઝઘડો/ચર્ચા કરવાની ક્રિયા.
words.usage_note: In many cultures, haggling is expected and seen as part of the shopping experience.
words.memory_tip: 'Haggle' = ઘા-ઘૂ → haggling = ઘા-ઘૂ કરી ભાવ ઘટાડ.
examples: Haggling is common in Turkish bazaars.
She improved her haggling skills on a trip to Morocco.
He is not comfortable with haggling.
A bit of haggling can save you a lot.

words.english_meaning: A set price that cannot be negotiated or changed.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક નક્કી ભાવ જે વાટાઘાટ અથવા બદલી ન શકાય.
words.usage_note: Supermarkets and malls typically have fixed prices; bazaars and markets often don't.
words.memory_tip: 'Fixed' = નક્કી + 'price' = ભાવ → fixed price = નક્કી ભાવ.
examples: The restaurant offers a fixed price lunch menu.
Their policy is fixed price — no negotiations.
Fixed price contracts help avoid disputes.
Unlike markets, malls have fixed prices.

words.english_meaning: A general increase in prices and fall in the purchasing value of money.
words.gujarati_meaning: ભાવ સ્તરમાં સામાન્ય વૃદ્ધિ અને પૈસાની ખરીદ-શક્તિ ઘટવી.
words.usage_note: Central banks raise interest rates to control inflation.
words.memory_tip: 'Inflate' = ફૂલવું → inflation = ભાવ ફૂલ્યા/ચઢ્યા.
examples: High inflation has made groceries expensive.
The inflation rate is 6% this year.
Inflation affects the purchasing power of citizens.
Governments try to keep inflation under control.

words.english_meaning: The most favorable price a buyer is willing to pay or a seller is willing to accept.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખરીદનાર ભરવા માટે અથવા વેચનાર સ્વીકારવા તૈયાર હોય તે સૌથી સારો ભાવ.
words.usage_note: Often abbreviated as 'OBO' (or best offer) in classified ads.
words.memory_tip: 'Best' = સૌથી સારો + 'offer' = ઑફર → best offer = સૌથી સારો/સસ્તો ભાવ.
examples: The listing says ₹10,000 or best offer.
She made her best offer, and they accepted.
What's your best offer for this car?
Best offers are often welcomed in second-hand markets.

words.english_meaning: When a store agrees to sell a product at the same price as a competitor.
words.gujarati_meaning: જ્યારે દુકાન સ્પર્ધક જેટલા ભાવે ઉત્પાદ વેચવા સહમત થાય.
words.usage_note: Many large retailers offer price-match guarantees to attract customers.
words.memory_tip: 'Price' = ભાવ + 'match' = સ્પર્ધક = price match = ભાવ મળ.
examples: The store will price match any competitor's offer.
She got a price match and saved ₹800.
Ask about price match guarantees before buying.
Their price match policy applies to online stores too.

words.english_meaning: The original listed price of a product before any discounts.
words.gujarati_meaning: ડિસ્કાઉન્ટ પહેલા ઉત્પાદ ઉપર લિસ્ટ કરેલ મૂળ ભાવ.
words.usage_note: The sticker price on a car is usually negotiable at dealerships.
words.memory_tip: 'Sticker' = ચોંટેલ ટૅગ + 'price' = ભાવ → sticker price = ટૅગ ઉપર ભાવ.
examples: The sticker price of the car was ₹8 lakh.
We negotiated below the sticker price.
Sticker prices are often higher than what you pay.
Never pay the sticker price without negotiating.

words.english_meaning: An arrangement with a bank to keep and manage your money.
words.gujarati_meaning: બૅન્ક સાથે પૈસા સુરક્ષિત રાખવા અને વ્યવસ્થાપિત કરવા માટેની વ્યવસ્થા.
words.usage_note: Types: savings account, current account, fixed deposit account.
words.memory_tip: 'Account' = 'ac' + 'count' = ગણ → account = ગણ ઠેલ (money counted and kept).
examples: She opened a savings account at the bank.
My account balance is very low this month.
Transfer the money to my account.
He has both a current and savings account.

words.english_meaning: Money placed into a bank account; also an advance payment to secure goods/services.
words.gujarati_meaning: બૅન્ક ખાતામાં મૂકેલ પૈસા; અથવા ચીજ/સેવા સુરક્ષિત કરવા અગ્રિમ ચૂકવણી.
words.usage_note: A security deposit is a refundable amount paid before renting.
words.memory_tip: 'De' + 'posit' = ઠેકાણે + મૂક → deposit = ઠેકાણે (bank) મૂકો.
examples: She deposited ₹5,000 in her account.
Pay a deposit to reserve the hall.
The deposit will be returned after the tenancy.
He made a cash deposit at the ATM.

words.english_meaning: Taking money out of a bank account.
words.gujarati_meaning: બૅન્ક ખાતામાંથી પૈસા ઉપાડવા.
words.usage_note: ATM withdrawals may be limited per day; bank withdrawals may need ID.
words.memory_tip: 'With' = સાથે + 'draw' = ખેંચ → withdrawal = ખાતામાંથી ખેંચ.
examples: I made a withdrawal of ₹2,000 from the ATM.
There's a daily withdrawal limit of ₹20,000.
She requested a withdrawal at the bank counter.
The withdrawal was processed instantly.

words.english_meaning: Money paid for the use of borrowed money, or earned on savings.
words.gujarati_meaning: ઉધાર પૈસા ઉપર ચૂકવાતી અથવા બચત ઉપર મળતી અધ-કચ.
words.usage_note: Simple interest vs. compound interest — compound grows faster.
words.memory_tip: 'Inter' = વચ્ચે + 'est' → interest = ઉધારી-ભરપાઈ વચ્ચે ઉમેરો.
examples: The bank pays 6% interest on savings.
He paid a lot of interest on his loan.
Interest rates are rising this year.
Compound interest grows faster than simple interest.

words.english_meaning: Money borrowed from a bank or person that must be repaid with interest.
words.gujarati_meaning: બૅન્ક અથવા વ્યક્તિ પાસેથી ઉધાર લીધેલ પૈسا, જ્યારે વ્યાજ સાથે ભરવા પડે.
words.usage_note: Types: personal loan, home loan, car loan, education loan.
words.memory_tip: 'Loan' = ઉધારી → 'lend' → loan = ઉધાર/વ્યાજ સાથે.
examples: She took out a loan to buy a car.
The bank approved his home loan.
Loan repayment begins after six months.
He is struggling to pay back the loan.

words.english_meaning: A loan taken to buy property, with the property as security.
words.gujarati_meaning: મિલ્કત ખરીદવા માટે લોન, જ્યાં મિલ્કત ગિરવી/ગેરેન્ટી તરીકે રહે.
words.usage_note: If mortgage payments are missed, the bank can repossess the property.
words.memory_tip: 'Mort' = મૃત્યુ + 'gage' = બંધ → mortgage = 'ભારે' દેવાનો બંધ.
examples: They took out a 20-year mortgage to buy their home.
The mortgage payment is ₹25,000 per month.
Rising mortgage rates affect homebuyers.
She finally paid off her mortgage.

words.english_meaning: A numerical rating that represents a person's creditworthiness based on financial history.
words.gujarati_meaning: આર્થિક ઇતિહાસ આધારે વ્યક્તિની ધિરાણ-પ્રાયોગ્યતા દર્શાવતો આંકડો.
words.usage_note: In India, CIBIL score (300–900) is widely used; 750+ is considered good.
words.memory_tip: 'Credit' = ઉધારી + 'score' = ગુણ → credit score = ઉધારી-ગુણ = ભરોસો!
examples: A good credit score helps you get loans easily.
Check your credit score before applying.
Paying bills on time improves your credit score.
His credit score dropped after missing a payment.

words.english_meaning: When you withdraw more money from your account than you have, creating a debt.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખાતામાં જેટલા પૈसा ન હોય તેના કરતા વધારે ઉપાડ, જે ઋણ સર્જે.
words.usage_note: Banks may charge fees or interest on overdraft amounts.
words.memory_tip: 'Over' = વધારે + 'draft' = ઉપાડ → overdraft = ખાતા કરતા વધારે ઉપાડ.
examples: He went into overdraft after paying his bills.
The bank charges ₹500 as an overdraft fee.
She arranged an overdraft facility with her bank.
Avoid overdraft to prevent extra charges.

words.english_meaning: A printed or digital record of all transactions in a bank account over a period.
words.gujarati_meaning: ચોક્કસ સમય દરમ્યાન બૅન્ક ખાતાના બધા વ્યવહારોનો છાપેલ/ડિજિટલ અહેવાલ.
words.usage_note: Bank statements are important for tax filings and financial record-keeping.
words.memory_tip: 'State' = જણાવ + 'ment' = → statement = ખાતાની જાણ-ચિઠ્ઠી.
examples: Please send me my bank statement.
She checked her statement for errors.
Monthly statements are available online.
The statement shows all deposits and withdrawals.

words.english_meaning: A type of savings where money is deposited for a fixed period at a set interest rate.
words.gujarati_meaning: એક પ્રકારની બચત જ્યાં ચોક્કસ સમય માટે નક્કી વ્યાજ-દરે પૈસા જમા થાય.
words.usage_note: FDs offer higher interest than savings accounts but are not accessible before maturity without penalty.
words.memory_tip: 'Fixed' = નક્કી + 'deposit' = જમા → fixed deposit = ચોક્કસ સમય નક્કી જમા.
examples: She invested in a fixed deposit for 3 years.
The fixed deposit earns 7% interest.
He broke his FD early to pay for emergency.
Fixed deposits are a safe investment option.

words.english_meaning: An instance of buying, selling, or transferring money.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખરીદ, વેચ, અથવા પૈसा ટ્રાન્સફરની ઘટના.
words.usage_note: Each purchase, transfer, or payment is recorded as a transaction.
words.memory_tip: 'Trans' = આ-તરફ-ઉ-તરફ + 'action' = ક્રિયા → transaction = બે-પક્ષ ક્રિયા.
examples: The transaction was completed in seconds.
Check your transaction history online.
This transaction is pending approval.
Every ATM withdrawal is a transaction.

words.english_meaning: The amount of money available in a bank account.
words.gujarati_meaning: બૅન્ક ખાતામાં ઉપલબ્ધ પૈसाની રકમ.
words.usage_note: 'Balance' can also mean the remaining amount owed on a debt.
words.memory_tip: 'Balance' = સ્થિર = ખાતામાં 'balance' = ઉપલબ્ધ.
examples: My account balance is ₹12,000.
Check your balance before making a payment.
The low balance alert saved me from overdraft.
She maintained a minimum balance of ₹10,000.

words.english_meaning: An asset pledged as security for a loan, which can be seized if the loan is not repaid.
words.gujarati_meaning: લોન માટે ગિરવી મૂકેલ સ્થાવર-જંગમ, ન ભરાય તો ઝૂંટવાઈ શકે.
words.usage_note: Common collaterals include property, gold, or fixed deposits.
words.memory_tip: 'Co' + 'lateral' = સાથે + બાજુ → collateral = બાજુ (side security).
examples: He offered his house as collateral for the loan.
Banks require collateral for large loans.
Gold jewellery is commonly used as collateral.
If you default, the bank takes the collateral.

words.english_meaning: One of several payments made at regular intervals for a purchase or loan.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખરીદ અથવા લોન માટે નિયમિત અંતરે ભરાતી અનેક ચૂકવણીઓ પૈકી એક.
words.usage_note: 'EMI' (Equated Monthly Instalment) is the Indian term for monthly loan instalments.
words.memory_tip: 'Install' = ઠેકઠેક ગોઠ → instalment = ઠેક-ઠેક ચૂક.
examples: She paid for the laptop in 12 instalments.
The monthly instalment is ₹3,500.
Buy now, pay later with easy instalments.
Missing an instalment attracts a penalty.

words.english_meaning: Money added to your account; also the ability to borrow money from a bank.
words.gujarati_meaning: ખાતામાં ઉમેરાયેલ પૈसा; અથવા બૅન્ક પાસેથી ઉધાર લેવાની ક્ષમતા.
words.usage_note: In banking: credit = money in (positive). Debit = money out (negative).
words.memory_tip: 'Cred' = ભરોસો (Latin) → credit = ભરોસા ઉપર ઉધારી.
examples: The refund was credited to my account.
She has a credit limit of ₹50,000 on her card.
His credit history is excellent.
Credit is useful but must be used wisely.

words.english_meaning: Money taken out of or charged to a bank account.
words.gujarati_meaning: બૅન્ક ખાતામાંથી ઉઠાવેલ અથવા ચાર્જ કરાયેલ પૈसा.
words.usage_note: A debit card uses your own money; a credit card uses borrowed money.
words.memory_tip: 'Debit' = 'D' for 'Down' → debit = ખાતું ડાઉન (પૈसा ઉઠ્ઠ).
examples: The amount was debited from my account immediately.
She uses a debit card for everyday shopping.
Direct debits automatically pay bills.
Check debit entries in your statement monthly.

words.english_meaning: The percentage charged on a loan or paid on savings over a period.
